regulatory_requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
regulatory_requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. Phone numbers should be in international E.164 format where possible.
regulatory_requirements.example: Contact: Maria García López | Business: Bloom & Petal Florist Ltd. | Phone: +34 612 345 678. For individual end users: Contact: John Smith | Business: N/A | Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567.

regulatory_requirements.name: Proof of Address (Local), with Local Activity Evidence
regulatory_requirements.description: Provide a document dated within the past 3 months that shows the supplied local service address in the country of the phone number. Accepted documents include bank statements, government letters, tax letters, invoices, bills, utility bills, or other official documents that verify the end user’s local address.  The document must show the individual’s name for personal end users, or the business name for business end users. Bank statements are an acceptable form of address verification when they show the required name, local service address, issuer, and date within the past 3 months.  Leases, rental agreements, or other documents with occupancy or contract terms are not accepted.
regulatory_requirements.example: A recent bank statement, government letter, tax notice, invoice, bill, or utility bill showing the individual’s name or business name and the supplied local service address, dated within the past 90 days.

regulatory_requirements.name: Company Registration Number — Portugal
regulatory_requirements.description: Enter the Company Registration Number shown on the Local Company Registration Certificate. The Business Registration Number in Portugal referred to Número de Identificação de Pessoa Coletiva (NIPC) also known as NIF (Número de Identificação Fiscal). The number must contain exactly 9 numeric characters.

regulatory_requirements.name: Local Company Registration Certificate — Portugal
regulatory_requirements.description: Upload an official document issued by a recognized Portuguese government authority or commercial registry confirming that the company is legally registered and authorized to conduct business in Portugal. The document must clearly display the registered legal company name, unique registration or incorporation number, date of registration or incorporation, registered business address, issuing authority, and the registry’s seal or letterhead. Submit a clear color scan or original PDF in Portuguese or English. Photographs, screenshots, and unsigned drafts are not acceptable.
regulatory_requirements.example: An official Portuguese company registration certificate or commercial registry extract showing the company’s legal name, 9-digit registration number, registration date, registered address, issuing registry, and official seal or letterhead.

regulatory_requirements.name: Address Matching the DID Area Code (Geographic Match)
regulatory_requirements.description: A physical address that matches the geographic area covered by the phone number's area code. The address must include street name and number, postal/ZIP code, city, and country, and the city/region of the address must fall within the geographic area assigned to the DID's area code. Addresses outside the area code's geographic region are not acceptable for this requirement; a different (broader, national-level) address requirement must be selected if the customer cannot provide a matching local address.
regulatory_requirements.example: 311 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 (matches Chicago area code 312). For a +44 20 (Greater London) DID: an address within Greater London such as '60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD'. The address must lie within the area code's geographic boundaries.

regulatory_requirements.name: Portuguese NIF (Número de Identificação Fiscal)
regulatory_requirements.description: The Portuguese tax identification number (Número de Identificação Fiscal, NIF), also known as the Número de Contribuinte, issued by the Portuguese Autoridade Tributária. Used to identify both individuals and businesses for tax purposes in Portugal. Format: exactly 9 numeric digits with no separators. Submitted value must match the regex ^[0-9]{9}$ and must correspond to the entity named on the order. The first digit indicates the entity type (1-3 for individuals, 5 for businesses, 6 for public entities, etc.).
regulatory_requirements.example: 123456789 (9 digits, numeric only). Format: NNNNNNNNN. Values shorter than 9 digits, longer than 9 digits, or containing any non-numeric character are not acceptable.

regulatory_requirements.name: Contact Email Address of End Client
regulatory_requirements.description: A valid email address for the end client (the natural person or business that will use the phone number), used for compliance follow-up. The submitted value must be a syntactically valid email address (max 150 characters) and should reach the end client directly. Generic or shared role-based addresses (e.g., info@, contact@) are acceptable but a personal address tied to the named end client is preferred.
regulatory_requirements.example: maria.garcia@bloomandpetal.com or contact@acme-coffee.de. The address must be syntactically valid (matching the standard email format) and should be a working address.

regulatory_requirements.name: Company Name (Full Legal Name)
regulatory_requirements.description: The full legal name of the company associated with the phone number, exactly as registered with the relevant national company registry. The name must include any legal suffix such as 'LLC', 'Ltd.', 'GmbH', 'S.A.', 'S.r.l.', or equivalent. Maximum 150 characters, minimum 1 character. Trade names and informal abbreviations without legal status are not acceptable; the registered legal name is required.
regulatory_requirements.example: Telnyx LLC, Acme Florist Limited, Bloom & Petal GmbH, or Empresa Ejemplo S.A. The submitted name must match the company's official registration certificate; informal trading names ('Acme', 'Bloom') without the legal suffix are not acceptable.
